Tinker: Arclight Vital Correctors is a Tinker, which slots into certain engineering-made equipment similar to a Gem. It allows the equipped player to use the equipment to attempt to perform a combat resurrection on another player. It has a chance to backfire, damaging the user instead. It can be used by non-engineers via one of four Engineering-made wrist armors: Overengineered Sleeve Extenders (Cloth), Needlessly Complex Wristguards (Leather), Complicated Cuffs (Mail), or Difficult Wrist Protectors (Plate). These items are Bind on Pickup, so non-engineers must acquire them via Crafting Orders.

.]] The Tishamaat is a yearly sacrament and holiday celebrated by the draenei. It is described as a time to reflect on the burdens of the past, learn from them, and commit to a path forward. Like most eredar's ancient traditions from Argus, the Tishamaat was abandoned as the draenei were constantly being on the run from the Burning Legion, which left little time to consider anything but survival: "tomorrow was not guaranteed, so yesterday might as well not exist". After the events on the Dragon Isles, however, Prophet Velen decided that the tradition should be revived and celebrated within the Exodar on Azeroth.
